history.description: Warm paper lanterns ascending in a sparse, gently swaying stream against a deep-blue night.
Scatter lantern positions and launch phases; vary size and ascent speed while preserving gentle sway and the 18-second loop.
adopt variant dusk: Dusty rose horizon to blue-violet overhead. Only the sky paint changes; all five lanterns retain their exact motion.

lines.comment: Blue-violet dusk fading into a dusty rose horizon.
A sparse scattering of very faint distant stars.
The whole paper lantern sways as a unit; its rise wraps only outside the wall.
Narrow crown and broad warm paper body.
A luminous central fold with darker seams along the sides.
The folded bottom lip, bright opening, and little heat source.

facts.frame: Each frame shows the whole wall (->wall width height units) and nothing outside it. The wall's centre is (0, 0), +x is right and +y is up, so a wall 16 wide and 9 tall runs from x -8 to 8 and y -4.5 to 4.5. Time runs from 0 to the scene's ->duration in seconds, and the window loops it. Colours are sRGB as typed: 0x808080 shows as mid grey.
